summary: Chunghwa Telecom filed a Form 6-K reporting the outcomes of its 2026 Annual General Meeting, including approval of a NT$5.2 per share cash dividend, amendments to the corporate charter, and release of non-competition restrictions on directors. No mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, or other special situations were involved. The filing is a routine periodic report of shareholder meeting results, not a special-situation event.
